DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia.

Based on your history of non-adherence to influenza treatment, combined with one week of fever (implied by the clinical picture of purulent sputum and shortness of breath), localized left chest pain, and a productive cough, the clinical presentation is highly suggestive of bacterial pneumonia. I will now request a Chest X-Ray to confirm the diagnosis and identify the affected lobe.
